blocks.text: הַפּוֹתֵחַ פִּתְחוֹ לְדוֹפְקֵי בִּתְשׁוּבָה: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא פְּתוּחָה יָדוֹ:
uncertainties: The word after הַפּוֹתֵחַ reads as פִּתְחוֹ, not פֶּתַח.
The dagesh in the bet of בִּתְשׁוּבָה is unclear.
וְ״מַ is the printed abbreviation for the refrain (וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים). It is kept exactly as printed and not expanded.

blocks.text: הַצּוֹפֶה לָרָשָׁע וְחָפֵץ בְּהִצָּדְקוֹ: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר:
הַקָּצַר בְּזַעַם וּמַאֲרִיךְ אַף: וְ״מ שֶׁהוּא קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס:
uncertainties: Under the bet of בְּזַעַם there is an extra mark that may be a meteg or a smudge, and the vowel under the zayin could be patach or qamats.
In this line the abbreviation looks like וְ״מ with no patach visible under the mem.
לִכְעוֹס is spelled plene, as printed.

blocks.text: הָרַחוּם, וּמַקְדִּים רַחֲמִים לְרֹגֶז: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא רַךְ לִרְצוֹת:

blocks.text: הַשָּׁוֶה, וּמַשְׁוֶה קָטוֹן וְגָדוֹל: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק:
קר״ס הַתָּם וּמִתַּמֵּם עִם תְּמִימִים: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא תָּמִים פָּעֳלוֹ:
uncertainties: There is a small abbreviation in the right margin before הַתָּם that reads as קר״ס. Its letters are uncertain; it may be a role or responsive cue, and the first letter could be a samekh.
The vowel under the ayin in פָּעֳלוֹ is read as chataf-qamats.

blocks.text: סוגרים הארון.
uncertainties: This is a small unpointed rubric. Read literally, the glyphs look like קונריס הארון. The reading סוגרים ('close the Ark') is an interpretation of the small type and is uncertain.

blocks.text: אין פֿראַנקפֿורט אַם מאַין, אונד פֿיעלען געמיינדען ווירד תִּשְׂגַּב ניכט געבעטעט.

blocks.text: ח״ תִּשְׂגַּב לְבַדֶּךָ וְתִמְלֹךְ עַל כֹּל בְּיִחוּד: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ

blocks.text: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:

וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־הַבְּרוּאִים וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אַחַת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשִּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶיךָ עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶךָ וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ:

blocks.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמֶּלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ:
He opens the gates for those who knock in repentance. All believe that His hand is open.
He waits for the evil-doer and delights in his justification. All believe that He is righteous and upright.
He shortens anger and holds back wrath. All believe that He is hard to anger.
Compassionate, He lets mercy precede wrath. All believe that He is soft to appease.
He is just and treats small and great equally. All believe that He is a righteous judge.
He is perfect and shows perfection with the flawless. All believe that His work is flawless.
In Frankfurt a. M. and many congregations תשוב is not said.
Thou alone wilt be exalted and reign alone over all. As it is written through Thy prophet: The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One.

And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou has created.

And therefore grant honour, O Lord, to Thy people, fame to those who fear Thee and praise to those who seek Thee and confidence to those who wait for Thee, joy to Thy land, happiness to Thy city and a rise of fortune to David Thy servant and an array of light to the son of Jesse Thine anointed speedily and in our days.

And thus may the righteous see and rejoice and the upright exult and the pious revel with joy. Vice shall close its mouth and all evil entirely disappear like smoke when Thou removest the dominion of arrogance from the earth.
In Fuerth and other communities the reader now sings: ויאתיו but in Frankfurt a. M., Metz and many communities this prayer is omitted.
All will come to serve Thee and praise Thy glorious Name. They will proclaim among the islands Thy righteousness. Peoples that did not know Thee will seek Thee, and all the ends of the earth will

praise Thee and constantly will they say: ‘great is the Lord’. (To Thee will they offer their sacrifices) they will abandon their idols and grow ashamed of their images. They will incline their shoulders in unison to serve Thee. At sunrise there will stand before Thee full of awe those who seek Thy countenance. They will acknowledge the power of Thy Kingdom, teach understanding to those who have strayed, talk of Thy might and praise Thee exalted supreme above all. Trembling will they appear before Thy countenance and crown Thee with a glorious crown so that the mountains will burst out in jubilation and the islands rejoice in Thy rule. They will accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom upon themselves, exalt Thee in the assembly of the people, those far away will hear and come and hand Thee the crown of the Kingdom.

And Thou, O Lord, shalt reign alone over all Thy works on Mount Zion, Thy glorious dwelling, and in Jerusalem, Thy Holy City, as it is written in Thy holy word, the Lord shall reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluyah!

Holy art Thou and awe-inspiring is Thy Name and there is no God beside Thee, as it is written, exalted is the Lord of Hosts through judgment and the Holy God is sanctified through righteousness. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the Holy King.
